title: Open browser
description: Starts a browser window for the actions that follow: size, device and language.

title: Sign in
description: Opens a window where you sign in yourself, once. Opsis keeps the sign-in, encrypted, and the actions after this one use it.

title: Start recording
description: The video starts here. The actions before it run off camera, like signing in and the first page load.

title: Go to page
description: Opens a page address.

title: Click
description: Moves the cursor to an element and clicks it.

title: Type text
description: Types into a field, key by key.

title: Hover
description: Moves the cursor over an element without clicking, so a menu or tooltip can appear.

title: Drag
description: Drags an element onto another one, by a distance, or along a path, like moving a card or drawing a shape.

title: Scroll
description: Scrolls to an element or by a distance.

title: Choose option
description: Picks an option in a dropdown.

title: Upload file
description: Attaches a file from your project to a file field.

title: Press keys
description: Presses a key or shortcut, like Ctrl+K. Shows in keystroke chips.

title: Wait
description: Waits for an element, a quiet page, an address, or a fixed time. Waiting for something is more reliable than a fixed time.

title: Check text
description: Stops the recording early if some text is not on the page, so you don't export a broken take.

title: Find element early
description: Looks an element up ahead of time so a later action doesn't pause on screen while searching.

title: Run page script
description: Runs a small script in the page, e.g. to skip onboarding or turn on a feature. Put it before Go to page to run it as the site first opens.

title: Fake a response
description: Makes the site show fixed data for matching requests made after it, so every take looks the same. Put it before Go to page to cover the first load.

title: Switch theme
description: Switches the page between light and dark, as changing the computer's setting would, without reloading it.

title: Change language
description: Changes the language the page is told the computer uses, as for a visitor from another country.

title: Freeze time
description: Pins the date and time the page sees, so clocks and "x minutes ago" never change between takes.

title: Hide clutter
description: Hides cookie banners, chat bubbles and anything else you list.

title: Chapter
description: Starts a new chapter. Can show a chapter card in the video.

title: HTML overlay
description: Shows your own HTML on top of the page while recording.

title: Open terminal
description: Starts a terminal for the actions that follow: its shell, folder and size.

title: Run command
description: Types a command, presses Enter and waits for it to finish.

title: Type
description: Types text into the terminal, one character at a time.

title: Press keys
description: Presses a key or a shortcut in the terminal.

title: Click
description: Clicks text or a cell, for programs that read the mouse.

title: Drag
description: Presses on one place, moves to another and lets go, for programs that read the mouse.

title: Mouse wheel
description: Turns the mouse wheel over text or a cell, for programs that read the mouse.

title: Wait for text
description: Waits until some text shows in the terminal.

title: Start recording
description: The film starts here. Actions before it set things up off camera.

title: Chapter
description: Starts a chapter of the film here, listed in exports.

title: Clear screen
description: Clears the terminal screen.

title: Record terminal take
description: Plays all connected terminal actions in one go and records the terminal.

title: Terminal look
description: The look of a terminal take: its colours, type size, spacing and cursor.

title: Cast file
description: Uses a terminal session recorded earlier and saved as a cast file as a take.

title: Play tape
description: Plays a tape file in a terminal and records it: what to type, the keys to press and the look of the terminal.

title: Export tape
description: Saves the connected terminal actions as a tape file, to play again or share.

title: Record take
description: Plays all connected browser actions in one go and records the screen.

title: Screenshot
description: Plays the connected actions, then takes a sharp screenshot of the page or one element. Frame image frames it; Use as clip shows it in the video.

title: Clip from take
description: Turns a take into a clip, shot the way its style says: the frame, the background and the camera moves. Browser takes play at 1.25×, terminal takes at their own speed; Speed changes it.

title: Camera
description: How the camera follows the take: zooming to each action or keeping the cursor in view, how close and how fast it moves.

title: Frame
description: How the take sits in the frame: a window with its title bar on a background, the whole page, or the screen of a laptop or phone.

title: Apply style
description: Gives every recording in a clip the same style, for takes joined in a Sequence or Layers.

title: Camera move
description: Moves the camera to a spot of your choice at a set time, from wherever it is or from another spot, and holds there.

title: Skip quiet parts
description: Speeds through moments where nothing happens.

title: Speed ramp
description: Speeds up or slows down chosen parts.

title: Crop
description: Cuts the recording down to an area.

title: Device frame
description: Puts the clip on a device's screen: a laptop or phone, a 3D screen, a pull back from a device, or a lineup of devices.

title: Motion blur
description: Adds blur to fast camera moves.

title: Cursor
description: Shows or hides the drawn cursor and sets its look, size and colours.

title: Click ripple
description: A ring that pulses on every click.

title: Keystroke chips
description: Shows keys and typed text as keycaps on screen.

title: Spotlight
description: Darkens everything except the element being used.

title: Highlight box
description: Draws a box around the element being used, cleanly or by hand.

title: Tooltip
description: A tooltip that stays attached to an element as the camera moves.

title: Callout arrow
description: A hand-drawn arrow pointing at an element, with a label.

title: Captions from script
description: Turns your script into timed captions at a natural speaking pace.

defaults.script: Record a real flow. Turn it into a cinematic demo.

title: Show captions
description: Displays captions over the video, word by word, karaoke or line by line.

title: Redact take
description: Hides parts of the browser window, such as names, email addresses and keys, behind large pixels, a blur or a solid colour. The areas stay on the page while the camera moves.

title: Grade footage
description: Applies a colour grade to the footage in a clip: the page in each recording, and each video and image. The window and backdrop keep their colours; to grade the whole picture, use Apply grade on an exported file.

title: Colour and light
description: Changes brightness, contrast, colour, warmth and the colour of shadows and highlights. Used by Apply grade.

title: Look file
description: Applies a colour look saved from another video editor. Used by Apply grade.

title: Black and white and tint
description: Turns the picture black and white, sepia or one tint of colour. Used by Apply grade.

title: Texture
description: Sharpens or softens the picture and adds dark edges and film grain. Used by Apply grade.

title: Lens
description: Adds colour fringing, bends the picture like a lens and leaves trails behind motion. Used by Apply grade.

title: Auto fix
description: Fixes a colour cast, stretches dull levels and smooths banding in skies. Used by Apply grade.

title: Title card
description: A full-screen title with an optional eyebrow and subtitle.

title: Lower third
description: A name or caption bar in the lower part of the screen.

title: Redact
description: Hides parts of the screen with large pixels, a blur or a solid colour, to keep keys, emails and personal details out of the film.

title: Light leak
description: A warm light flare over the video.

title: Ink underline
description: A hand-dragged brush underline that sweeps itself across in a few stop-motion poses, thinning to a dry tail.

title: Scribble circle
description: A brush circle swept around a region of the frame, opening thin and closing thick, with grain breaking up the dry opening.

title: Keystroke
description: Shows a keyboard shortcut as keycaps being pressed.

title: Confetti
description: A burst of confetti to celebrate a moment.

title: Radial burst
description: Sculptural ribbons twist into a tilted ring and sweep outward through contour echoes for an expressive product introduction.

title: Polaroid
description: An instant-photo frame with a handwritten caption for video, images, or live compositions.

title: TV power off
description: End a scene the way a tube does: the picture collapses into a glowing horizontal line, the line pinches to a phosphor dot, the dot decays, and the frame is left dead black.

title: Speed lines
description: Streaks shoot across the frame toward a point and die as they land, or radial focus lines rush in from the edges and snap onto one point for an impact frame. Lay it over a clip with Layers.

title: Terminal simulator
description: Terminal window that types out commands and rolls old lines off the top.

title: Check list
description: A handwritten checklist that writes itself out in full, then ticks and strikes through every done item, one at a time.

title: Search reveal
description: Expanding construction circles snap into a search pill, type editable text, and reveal an abstract graphic panel.

title: Agent run
description: An AI assistant working through a plan, ticking off each step.

defaults.runPrompt: Why did checkout conversion drop last week?
runPlan: Compare the checkout funnel with the week before
Break the drop down by device and step
Check what shipped and what the error logs say

runSteps.name: Query analytics
runSteps.detail: checkout funnel, last 7 days vs prior 7

defaults.runAnswer:
## Card payments broke on tablets in release 4.12

Checkout conversion fell from 3.4% to 2.7% last week, a 21% drop [1]. All of it comes from the payment step on tablets, 41% of checkouts [2].

- Tablet conversion halved, from 3.5% to 1.8%
- Phones and desktops held steady at 3.3%
- 4.12 moved the card form into a frame without the payment permission [3]

```tsx
<iframe
  src={cardFormUrl}
  allow="payment"
/>
```

**Fix:** add the permission and ship 4.12.1 today.

title: Signup flow
description: A sign-up form that fills itself in, step by step.

defaults.title: Create an account
defaults.description: Enter your information below to create your account
defaults.emailHelp: We'll use this to contact you.
defaults.passwordHelp: Must be at least 8 characters long.

title: AI prompt flow
description: An AI prompt composition: a prompt types into the field, the Generate button runs hover → press → loading, a skeleton shimmer reveals, then crossfades into the generated answer, and a ready toast slides in. A pure orchestrator — the shimmer is owned by the skeleton-block motion atom; every other channel comes from a composed primitive's hook.

answerLines: The thread debates the Q3 roadmap: ship the editor first,
defer billing to Q4, and pull the migration forward so
infra is unblocked before the team scales next quarter.

title: Command menu
description: A command palette that opens, filters and picks an item.

title: Announce title
description: Launch title animation, product announcement intro with kinetic typography. A four-shot launch title: the eyebrow rushes past the camera on a receding type plane and lands on a colour field, the name assembles word by word on paper, and a macro pan across the tagline cuts wide as the line builds itself last word first while a white sweep drains it out of colour.

defaults.title: Acme 2.0
defaults.tagline: Everything your team needs to ship, in one place.

title: Punch lines
description: Kinetic typography title cards: bold statements that cut hard between beats. A run of full-frame title cards that cut hard between beats.

defaults.script: Record it. / Edit it. | One take. | Ship.

title: Text highlight
description: Brings attention to one word in a sentence: a marker sweeps behind it, its colour changes, a line draws under it, it is struck out and replaced, or a shine passes over it.

title: Status cycle
description: Status badge animation: a pill whose label cycles through states. A centred line whose status pill cycles: the label rolls up behind a hard clip while the pill's width springs past its target and back, and the line re-centres around it.

defaults.chips: Record, Auto zoom, Captions, Export, Share

title: Hero launch
description: Product launch hero scene for a SaaS launch video intro. Cinematic product-launch hero — two cards slide into formation as the headline reveals above.

title: Steps timeline
description: A row of steps that check off one after another along a line, each with its title and a short description.

steps.title: Proof
steps.description: Show the chart and the numbers.

steps.title: Next step
steps.description: Close with one clear call to action.

title: Pricing card
description: A pricing plan card: the price rolls in, then each feature is ticked off.

title: Plan comparison table
description: A table comparing plans feature by feature, with one plan highlighted.

title: Changelog
description: A release note: version and date, then each change appears with its own tag.

changes.text: Render API webhooks on job completion
Retry backoff no longer stalls the queue
Theme tokens moved to a single source

defaults.summary: Captions, webhooks, and a queue that stops sulking.

title: End card
description: A closing card with a title, a button, your web address and social handles.

defaults.title: Ready to try it?
defaults.subtitle: Start free. No credit card needed.

title: Kanban board
description: A task board where cards move from one column to the next.

title: File tree
description: A folder tree that opens one item at a time and highlights a file.

title: File upload
description: A pointer drags a file into an upload area, which catches it and uploads it.

defaults.label: Drop your clip
defaults.hint: MP4 or MOV, up to 2 GB

title: Commit graph
description: A version history graph that draws its branches and merges commit by commit.

title: Notification stack
description: Notifications slide in, stack up and dismiss themselves.

toasts.title: Storage at 86%
toasts.body: Archive old renders to free space

title: Text mask
description: Big letters with a video, image or gradient showing through them.

title: Animated text
description: A line of text that comes in with the animation you pick.

title: Arrow
description: An arrow that draws itself to point at something, clean with a label or hand-drawn with a brush.

title: Background
description: A background to put behind other layers: a colour, a gradient, a texture or a moving pattern.

title: Logo set
description: A set of logos shown together: a grid that lights up, a field drifting past a headline, or a stack of chips.

title: Logo reveal
description: Brings in your logo and name: drawn as an outline, assembled from orbiting cards, or wiped in behind a spinning mark.

title: Code reveal
description: A code editor that writes out a file, then highlights the lines that matter.

title: Code diff
description: A code editor that changes one version of a file into another.

title: Chart
description: A chart that animates in from your numbers.

title: Metric cards
description: Key numbers that count up: several on cards with their trends, or one in a filling ring.

title: Rolling number
description: A value that rolls to its target: digits like an odometer, or a reel that rolls any characters.

title: Film look
description: Shows a clip as if seen through something: an old screen, a tape, a printed page or a camera lens.

title: 3D object
description: A logo, an image card, text or a model in 3D, turning under studio lights.

title: Transition
description: Brings a clip in with a transition wherever it is joined after another clip in a Sequence. Its Transition output sets the joins of a whole Sequence or Repeat.

title: Music
description: Background music under the video, with fades.

title: Sound effect
description: A sound from a file or made from settings, at a set time, on a browser action, or building up to end exactly on an action, a marker or the end of a clip.

title: Add sound
description: Puts sounds under a clip. Connect as many as you like. Sound stops where the clip ends.

title: Action sounds
description: A click sound at every click and a key sound at every keystroke of the takes in a clip, on one Mixer channel.

title: Room tone
description: A quiet bed of soft noise under the whole video, so cuts and silent stretches don't drop to dead silence.

title: Transition sounds
description: A whoosh at every transition in a clip, timed to its middle and fitted to its length, on one Mixer channel.

title: Sequence
description: Plays clips one after another. Each join uses the transition its clip comes in with, else the one on the Transition input, else a plain cut.

title: Layers
description: Stacks clips on top of each other: Layer 1 at the back, the last at the front.

title: Trim
description: Keeps only part of a clip.

title: Repeat
description: Plays a clip several times, with the transition on its Transition input at each seam.

title: Delay
description: Starts a clip later.

title: Chapter
description: Starts a chapter where a clip begins, for an export's chapters.

title: Speed
description: Plays a clip faster or slower.

title: Fit length
description: Makes a clip a set length, or as long as a sound, by speeding up, holding or cutting.

title: Choose by variable
description: Uses the first clip when a variable has a value, or the value you give, otherwise the second. Handy for A/B versions.

title: Media file
description: A video, image or sound from your project. Drop files on the canvas to add one.

title: Use as clip
description: Turns a file into a clip you can place in the video: an image, a video or an animation.

title: Trim file
description: Cuts a file down to a start and end. Makes a new file.

title: Join files
description: Joins files end to end. Fast when they match, otherwise converts them. Makes a new file.

title: Change speed
description: Speeds a file up or slows it down. Makes a new file.

title: Reverse
description: Plays a file backwards. Makes a new file.

title: Resize
description: Resizes a file, adding bars or cropping to fit. Makes a new file.

title: Convert
description: Saves a file in another format or quality. Makes a new file.

title: Apply grade
description: Applies a colour grade to a whole video or image file: everything in the picture, window and backdrop included. Makes a new file.

title: Make GIF
description: Turns a video into a GIF with clean colours. Makes a new file.

title: Extract sound
description: Saves the sound of a video as its own file. Makes a new file.

title: Even out volume
description: Makes the sound as loud as most online videos. Makes a new file.

title: Fix clicks
description: Removes clicks and pops from a recording. Makes a new file.

title: Fix clipping
description: Rebuilds peaks that were cut off when the sound was recorded too loud. Makes a new file.

title: Remove hum
description: Removes mains hum and its harmonics from a recording. Makes a new file.

title: Sound picture
description: Draws a sound's waveform or spectrum as an image.

title: Remove noise
description: Takes background noise and low rumble out of a voice recording. Makes a new file.

title: Soften “s” sounds
description: Softens harsh “s” sounds in a voice recording. Makes a new file.

title: Change pitch
description: Raises or lowers a sound's pitch in semitones while its length stays, to fit a song's key or make a playful voice. Makes a new file.

title: Voice effects
description: Makes a voice or a sound sound like a telephone, a radio, a small room, a hall or an echo. Makes a new file.

title: Fit music to the film
description: Makes a song end with the film: stretched a little, or looped with a crossfade, then faded. Makes a new file.

title: Shorten pauses
description: Shortens long silences in a voice recording without cutting words. Use it on a voice before placing it against a take. Makes a new file.

title: Grab frame
description: Saves one frame of a video as an image. Makes a new file.

title: Resize image
description: Makes an image a chosen width, height or both. Makes a new file.

title: Crop image
description: Keeps one part of an image: an area you draw on it, or what's inside margins. Makes a new file.

title: Rotate and flip
description: Turns an image in quarter turns, flips it, or straightens it by a small angle. Makes a new file.

title: Place image
description: Puts a second image, such as a logo or a watermark, on top of an image. Makes a new file.

title: Image format
description: Saves an image as PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF. Makes a new file.

title: Redact
description: Hides parts of an image, such as names, email addresses and keys, behind large pixels, a blur or a solid colour. Makes a new file.

title: Spotlight
description: Darkens or blurs everything outside the areas you draw, so the eye goes to them. Makes a new file.

title: Trim empty edges
description: Cuts away even-coloured margins, so the content sits tight. Makes a new file.

title: Make a colour transparent
description: Makes a flat background, such as a logo's white, see-through. Makes a new file.

title: Outline
description: Draws a coloured outline around the visible part of a see-through image, for cutouts and logos. Makes a new file.

title: Grid
description: Puts any number of images in a row, a column or a grid, with gaps and a background. Makes a new file.

title: Frame image
description: Frames an image for a post: plain with rounded corners and a soft shadow, in a window with its title bar, or on a laptop or phone, flat or tilted, on a padded background.

title: Before and after
description: Shows two pictures side by side, stacked, or split by a divider, with Before and After labels. Makes a new file.

title: Magnify
description: Shows one part of an image enlarged in a circle or a rounded box beside it, joined to the spot by a line, so small text reads. Makes a new file.

title: Compare screenshots
description: Boxes what changed between two captures of the same page, and makes a picture of only the differences. Makes a new file.

title: Annotate
description: Draws arrows, boxes, ovals, numbered steps and text on a picture, so a still explains itself. Makes a new file.

title: Export video
description: Renders the final video, one file per shape (16:9, 9:16…).

title: Export images
description: Saves a frame as images at social sizes: wide, link preview, square, portrait, story.

title: Save take
description: Saves a take's own recording as a file, as it was recorded: a video for a browser take, a cast file for a terminal take.

title: Group
description: Boxes nodes together. Select nodes, then Group.

title: Note
description: A sticky note on the canvas. Not part of the video.
